mainEntity.name: Can AI answer member questions without making my community feel impersonal?

acceptedAnswer.text:
AI can draft responses to common questions, summarize relevant lessons, and suggest links to approved resources, but it should not be the only support channel. Members need a clear way to reach a person when the question is unusual, sensitive, disputed, or not covered by the source material.

Context: Run My AI Biz’s support-related examples include first-line support workflows and coordination between specialized assistants. Those examples are starting points for structured assistance, not evidence that every response can be safely automated.

Key factors:
- Complexity and sensitivity of member questions
- Accuracy of the knowledge base
- Response-time expectations
- Escalation access to the owner or moderator

Practical guidance: Create approved answer templates, require citations or source links internally, and route uncertain answers for review. Audit a sample of replies regularly.

This approach lets Run My AI Biz support education about AI-assisted operations while preserving a personal support experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: It can help with routine questions if replies use approved sources, match the community voice, and offer human escalation. Keep personal, sensitive, disputed, or uncertain questions with a person, and review early AI replies before expanding the workflow.
